text:
Situation: Corvale East has 6.2 days on hand of clindamycin in 5 percent dextrose 6 mg/mL 50 mL bags (NDC 0781-3288-09, labeled by Sandoz Inc., manufacturing plant InfoRLife SA). Corvale Lakeside holds 19.2 days on hand of the same product. Corvale General holds 11.6 days on hand of the same strength and container. Alternative clindamycin phosphate presentations are stocked at all sites with 11.6 to 19.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the clindamycin phosphate injection shortage on 2023-03-21 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspected Bryant Ranch PrePack (FEI 1000519407) on 2022-03-17, classified VAI, letter dated 2022-05-19 — 369 days before the shortage posting. Subsequent inspections of that plant on 2023-06-16 and 2024-01-25 were also classified VAI, with letters issued after the shortage posting. Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) was inspected on 2023-06-16 and classified VAI, 87 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: The shortage is ongoing per FDA. Internal redistribution can modestly improve Corvale East coverage. External purchases from suppliers not on FDA's shortage list are available but require buyer execution.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 21 bags of clindamycin in 5 percent dextrose 6 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Civica, Inc. (plant InfoRLife SA) — approved by buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes; those are for the treating clinicians and the committee.
